Our manifesto

2026 and thriving

AI doesn't replace WordPress. It supercharges it.

Some people worry AI will make website platforms obsolete. We see the opposite: AI is the best thing to happen to publishing in years, and WordPress — open, structured, and API-rich — is exactly where that power lands best. Here's why the two were made for each other.

AI is brilliant at filling the page. WordPress makes sure the page is yours — owned, durable, discoverable, and free. The model drafts; the platform endures.

Concretely useful

Six ways AI makes WordPress lovelier

Not hype — practical wins you can feel on day one, all built on the structured foundation blocks give you.

AI-assisted writing

Draft, expand, summarize, or rewrite right inside the editor. The block model means generated text lands as clean, structured content — not a tangle of divs you have to untangle later.

Content

Block & pattern generation

Describe a section — "a pricing table with three tiers" — and have it assembled from real blocks you can then tweak. Because patterns are just block markup, AI output is fully editable, not locked.

Layout

Automatic alt text

AI can describe every image you upload, generating thoughtful alt text at scale. Accessibility that used to be skipped under deadline pressure becomes effortless and consistent.

Accessibility

Instant translation

WordPress already speaks dozens of languages with mature i18n. Pair it with AI translation and a multilingual site becomes a draft-and-review job, not a months-long project.

Global

Site-building copilots

Conversational tools can scaffold a starter site — pages, menus, a theme, sample patterns — in minutes. You begin from a thoughtful draft instead of a blank screen, then make it truly yours.

Onboarding

MCP & automation

WordPress's REST API and emerging Model Context Protocol support let AI agents safely read and write your site — schedule posts, tidy taxonomies, bulk-edit — against a stable, permissioned interface.

Agents

Built for this moment

WordPress is unusually AI-ready

Great AI integrations need three things: structured content, a clean API, and an open platform you can extend. WordPress has had all three for years — long before they were fashionable.

  • Structured by blocks. Content has shape, so AI can target it precisely instead of guessing at raw HTML.
  • A first-class REST API. Every post, page, and setting is reachable and permissioned — ideal for safe automation.
  • Open and hookable. Anyone can build an AI plugin, block, or MCP server without asking a gatekeeper.
  • Your data stays yours. You decide what AI touches, where it runs, and what it keeps.
# An AI agent drafts a post — safely,
# through the WordPress REST API.

POST /wp-json/wp/v2/posts
Authorization: Bearer ••••••••

{
  "title":   "Drafted by my copilot",
  "status":  "draft",
  "content": "<!-- wp:paragraph -->…"
}

# → 201 Created. You review, edit,
#   and publish on your terms.

A healthy workflow

AI drafts. You decide. WordPress keeps.

1 · Generate

Ask AI for a draft post, a layout, alt text, or a translation. It arrives as real, editable blocks.

2 · Refine

You bring judgment, voice, and accuracy. The block editor makes shaping the output quick and pleasant.

3 · Own

Publish to your own domain, your database, your audience. It's indexed, portable, and permanently yours.

4 · Endure

Years from now it still loads, still ranks, still belongs to you — no platform can revoke it. That's the difference.

Real worries, real answers

The questions everyone's asking in 2026

Generating a site is the easy 10%. The other 90% is living with it — editing for years, owning the data, controlling SEO, adding a store, staying portable, and never being locked out. WordPress is the durable home that AI-generated content needs to thrive in.
Not on WordPress. Block themes and theme.json give you a real, distinctive design system, and you can restyle everything visually. AI provides a strong starting point; your taste and brand make it unmistakably yours.
You stay in control. The REST API is permissioned, agents can be scoped to drafts only, and an emerging MCP layer adds clear, auditable boundaries. AI proposes; you approve. Nothing publishes without your say-so.
It's the opposite. Pairing AI with an open, self-hosted platform is how you get the speed of AI and the freedom of ownership. You don't have to trade one for the other — that's the whole joy of WordPress in 2026.

The future is AI-assisted and self-owned.

Let the models do the heavy lifting. Keep the words, the data, and the freedom for yourself. That's WordPress in the AI era.
